opt-invkey-hint: Your inventory key opens THIS window instead of the vanilla one - handy when mounted and unable to look at the animal's saddlebags. Turn this off to get the normal inventory/character (armour) screen on that key again.
opt-character-hint: Adds your worn armour/clothing slots to the window, so it fully replaces the vanilla inventory screen. Off keeps armour on the vanilla screen only.
opt-adjacent-hint: One right-click on a chest also opens every chest of the same kind nearby, docking the whole wall into the window at once. Locked or claimed chests stay shut.
opt-sort-hint: Checked categories are placed into your worn backpacks before anything else, so what you reach for stays on you. The belt/hotbar is never touched by sorting.
opt-food-spoil-hint: Limits the Food category to food that will spoil within this many days. 0 = all food. Non-perishing food (dried, preserved) is never matched above 0.
opt-food-freshness-hint: Within a food group, orders by remaining freshness - soonest to spoil first - so what to eat next sits at the front.
opt-mount-hint: Elk saddlebags and pack-animal bags of the mount you are riding appear in the window automatically. Nearby boats open all their crates at once.
